meta.title: Deep PTC Mode
meta.description: Deep PTC builds on official PTC with interruptible jobs, selectable shells and a conversation-side panel. A task brief files the goals, constraints and acceptance criteria in your messages, quoting your words, and can take the raw messages out of the model's context once you confirm it. Click output files to open them; drag the panel edge to resize it, and place the capsule below the composer, in its toolbar or nowhere. Use drawing, design and research tools on demand, with general SSH and DSH Go assistance. The UI follows DSH's Chinese or English setting.
